path_repair.reason: The two launch commands omitted --results-dir and wrote to the persistent default results directory.
path_repair.action: Copy the existing result, checkpoint, milestone, train-log, and manifest artifacts without overwrite into the declared campaign root.

interpretation: The two-FFN blocks10+11 intervention is the first clearly promising short-horizon family: learned and frozen sparse models both exceed the equal-total-parameter dense control, while the one-FFN block11 and low-conflict block1 learned variants do not. The small learned-minus-frozen increment and route reliance below 0.002 make fixed expert partitioning or multi-layer structured regularization more plausible than useful learned conditional routing at this milestone.
largest_threat: This is exploratory seed 0 after multiple placement and router-state comparisons, and epoch5 accuracy is still low; the apparent two-layer advantage may be trajectory noise or a fixed-partition effect.
sharp_falsifier: At epoch10, the blocks10+11 triplet must retain a sparse-over-dense advantage with healthy routing; the block10 triplet and completed block1 placebo must not reproduce an equally large nonspecific effect. A learned-routing claim additionally requires a stable learned-over-frozen gap and materially larger route reliance.
multiplicity: Exploratory seed-0 selection over placement, one-versus-two FFNs, router state, and horizon; any winner requires locked fresh seeds.
